STICKYBOMBRICE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}can attack targets in the lane above or below, prioritizes leftmost zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can lob backwards
{KEYWORD}Damage Details: {STAT}exploding sticky bombs trigger other sticky bombs

{FLAVOR}Stickybomb Rice has extreme confidence in bombs, rice, and the abstract concept of stickiness. She's published scholarly articles about all three.
STICKYBOMBRICE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Stickybomb Rice lobs sticky rice bombs with timers at zombies.
STRAWBURST_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to fire

{FLAVOR} "Big is good," says Strawburst. "Though small’s pretty choice as well. And you should never discount medium. I just like sizes, really."
STRAWBURST_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Strawbursts grow a berry for small, medium or huge damage!
STRAWBURST_TOOLTIP: Grows a berry for small, medium or huge damage
STUNION_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates on contact

{FLAVOR}Oh sure, everyone knows Stunion as the battle-hardened warrior with the potent breath. But he’s so much more than that. He’s an accomplished pianist. He speaks five languages fluently. Heck, he's the leader of a Cub Shallots group in his spare time. Dude’s got layers. Go on, peel 'em back. You’ll see.
STUNION_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Stunions breathe a stunning cloud of gas on nearby zombies in the lane.
STUNION_TOOLTIP: Stuns nearby zombies in the lane
SUCCULENTGRAPE_DESCRIPTION: In the grape family, Succulent Grape has always been the third child, but every time people mention that he is not like Grapeshot and Microwave Grapes, he always says that he is the youngest (a little secret: Succulent Grape is actually short-sighted).
SUCCULENTGRAPE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Succulent Grape lobs explosive grapes above his head, dealing stun damage.
SUNBEAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, on being eaten
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}infected zombie drops 0.2 sun per hitpoint, up to 300 sun per Sun Bean

{FLAVOR}As the eldest of the bean brothers, Sun Bean often finds his siblings exasperating. Chili Bean is a little crude, Laser Bean is too far out, and Spring Bean is just plain lazy. Still, he loves them just the same. That's how it is with family.
SUNBEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Sun Beans infect zombies with sun. As a zombie takes damage it generates sun.
SUNBEAN_TOOLTIP: Zombies that eat it drop sun when damaged
SUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}After the release of her first major YouTuber video "Zombies On Your Lawn," Sunflower's YouTuber channel has been bursting with fun. She is currently putting the final touches on her reality show TV pitch "Sunflower Thinks She Can Dance."
SUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Sunflowers are essential for you to produce extra sun. Try planting as many as you can!
SUNSHROOM_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Oh sure, Sun-shroom is known for his ever-present grin and sunny disposition. But truth be told, even he has his dark days. It ain't easy keeping things light when you live in the shadows.
SUNSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Sun-shrooms give small suns at first, then normal suns, and finally large suns.
SWEETPEA_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}No one knows what flavor their candy is, and those who try to find out get trapped in a rabbit hole of chocolate factory conspiracies, government cover-ups, and missing Zombie reports. However, Sweet Pea doesn't get why their cherry flavor has such a direct reaction. "Trust me, I'm as lost as you."
SWEETPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Sweet Pea shoots candy peas that split into shards upon contact, spreading out and dealing damage to other zombies.
SWEETPOTATO_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Sweet Potato really is as sweet as she looks. Her favorite animal is the unicorn. Her favorite color is (and this is a direct quote) "all the colors of the rainbow." When she writes the letter "i", she draws a little heart where the dot belongs. Frankly, if it were anyone else, this amount of syrup would be sickening. But on her, well, it just seems right.
SWEETPOTATO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Sweet Potatoes attract zombies from other lanes when they are close by.
SWEETPOTATO_TOOLTIP: Attracts zombies from other lanes when they are close
TALLNUT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blocks launched imps

{FLAVOR}Tall-nut is opening a chain of stores for Tall and Taller gentlemen. "I'll shell out the savings to you!"
TALLNUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Tall-nuts are heavy-duty wall plants that block low flying zombies.
TALLNUT_TOOLTIP: Heavy-duty wall that blocks low flying zombies
TANGLEKELP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, on contact

{FLAVOR}Tangle Kelp likes to go deep. He majored in philosophy. Grab a root beer with him, and he'll go on and on about Nietzsche's "Thus Spoke Zucchini" or hold forth on Kant's "Critique of Petunia Reason." It's cool and all, but sometimes you just want to keep the conversation light. Sometimes you just want to talk about the temperature of the water.
TANGLEKELP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Tangle Kelp are aquatic plants that pull the first zombie that nears them underwater.
TANGLEKELP_TOOLTIP: Aquatic plant that pulls a zombie underwater
TELEPORTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use

{FLAVOR}Teleportato Mine is an avid film and movie fan, she'll ramble on and on about all the cool effects and physical props for them, to the point where she attempts to recreate them with a pretty decent success rate. Her recent obsession? Starch Trek. Cross your fingers and hope she doesn't watch the Termitater.
TELEPORTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Teleportato Mine instantly teleports zombies to her location, then explodes.
TELEPORTATOMINE_TOOLTIP: Teleports zombies to explode alongside them
THREEPEATER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Threepeater loves playing multiplayer in video games, but split-screen never works out because the left head always cheats.
THREEPEATER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Threepeaters shoot peas in three lanes.
THYMEWARP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}rewound zombies have restored health

{FLAVOR} "Possibilities other to open be to need we." Warp Thyme says, "Limited too far was time to approach unidirectional the that felt always I've."
THYMEWARP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Thyme Warps rewind time, sending zombies back where they started.
THYMEWARP_TOOLTIP: Sends zombies back where they started
TIGERGRASS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}grass tiger grows over time

{FLAVOR}"How many Grass Tigers could a Tiger Grass amass before they'd tire of making Grass Tigers?" We've presented this riddle to both the Sphinx and The Grate Mystery, and even they still couldn't solve it, and they studied the Suburban Almanac cover to cover.
TIGERGRASS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Tiger Grass spawns a grass tiger who leaps out to attack nearby zombies.
TOADSTOOL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}takes 25 seconds to swallow a zombie
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}deals damage to zombies that can't be gulped

{FLAVOR}Toadstool just can’t stand being idle. "I keep everything that I want to do on lists, and keep the lists where I can see them so that I’m always motivated!" she said. Whenever there’s work to be done, she’s always the first to hop to it.
TOADSTOOL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Toadstools gulp down zombies whole, then produce sun.
TOADSTOOL_TOOLTIP: Gulps down zombies whole, then produces sun.
TORCHWOOD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}multiple torchwoods increase strength of fire peas
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}does minor lane-wide fire damage when destroyed
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}Torchwood and Snapdragon have become fast friends. They like to hang out at either the Tiki Lounge or the Renaissance Faire.
TORCHWOOD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Torchwoods turn peas that pass through them into fireballs that deal twice as much damage. They also deal lanewide fire damage on defeat.
TORCHWOOD_TOOLTIP: Turns peas into fireballs and does lanewide damage on defeat
TUMBLEWEED_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}set aflame by Torchwood
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can be planted on top of other plants

{FLAVOR}This zesty little guy can't wait to get at it! Places to do! Things to go! It works because he planned thoroughly ahead of time.
TUMBLEWEED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Tumbleweeds roar off down the lane, bouncing off zombies and knocking them back with a chance to stun them.
TURKEYPULT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}turkeys naturally rot over time and disappear

{FLAVOR}Turkey-pult’s turkeys are so delicious, you’d never know they were actually made of tofu! Almost never. You might know. Okay, fine, cards on the table: there is absolutely no way you could ever mistake these turkeys for the real thing.
TURKEYPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Turkey-pults lob tofu turkeys that damage zombies and then charge down the lane to damage even more zombies.
TWINSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Twin Sunflower's super-chic line of ultra-expensive sunglasses has been a huge hit wherever she goes. Due to this she has been unable to travel without being swarmed by the Poppyrazzi.
TWINSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Twin Sunflowers give twice as much sun as a normal sunflower.
TWINSUNFLOWER_TOOLTIP: Gives twice as much sun as a sunflower
ULTOMATO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can be planted on top of itself, mutating from green to yellow to red
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}costs more sun the more Ultomatoes are on the board

{FLAVOR}Ultomato yawns as unimaginable energies build up inside his being. It’s cool. He can afford to wait. He’s got allllll day.
ULTOMATO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Ultomatoes charge up slowly, then fire a devastating beam down the lane that damages zombies as long as the charge lasts. Ultomatoes can be made more powerful by planting multiple Ultomatoes on the same tile.
UNUSED_43_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}stun stops Gentleman Zombies from flying

{FLAVOR}Some folks confuse Fanilla for a wind turbine. Others confuse him for a zombie, because he has really bad breath and makes no effort to change that. Fanilla isn’t good at making positive first impressions.
UNUSED_43_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Fanillas shoot stunning wind, which gets more powerful as it goes down the lane.
UNUSED_45_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}potions slow down zombies and pierce through armor

{FLAVOR}Lily of Alchemy learned the ancient art of potion-making from Old Man Josslehoof, who taught her the exact ingredients for the perfect, top secret anti-Zombie chemicals in her potions. Old Man Josslehoof also lives in a sewer and frequently combats giant dwarf overlords, according to Lily. What a guy.
UNUSED_45_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Lily of Alchemy lobs flower buds and has a chance to throw armor-piercing, stalling potions.
UNUSED_46_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}water pellets evaporate shortly after being fired

{FLAVOR}Lotus Root is a senior environmentalist. Whenever he sees smog in the sky, something just snaps within him. It triggers the few remaining braincells left from inhaling so much steam. The rage... the fury... it just makes him want to shoot something! Plant, zombie, doesn't matter! Lotus Root needs to blow off some steam, and you better make sure you're not near him when he does!
UNUSED_46_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Lotus Roots spray a flurry of water pellets at zombies in their lanes. Pellets will scatter after being shot, making damage more effective the closer targets are.
UNUSED_47_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}targets leftmost zombies that are 3 columns ahead or behind it
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can be planted on water

{FLAVOR}Cattail is very active on social media, notably on Leafter. She’s mostly known for being an icon of "Cat-Like Creatures who are not actually Cats" independence and frequently voices her controversial opinions on various cat foods.
UNUSED_47_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Cattails launch homing spikes at zombies near them.
UNUSED_48_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^00CCA3^Part of the UniverZ Collides collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Alternate UniverZ.

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}deals damage to zombies that can't be transformed
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}targets Wizard and Frog Sorceress Zombies first
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}After long studies, Void Orchid discovered a way to travel through the Multiverse itself. "On this Arcane Annual I will have the crowd all to myself", she says, "Look who's superior now, Hazel!" She will have to leave that thought for later though, as now she has a pending lawsuit for bringing zombie species that aren't welcome in our habitat. As if zombies in general were welcome here.
UNUSED_48_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Void Orchids use their dark energy to convert zombies into gravity spheres that pull in nearby zombies from other lanes.
UNUSED_49_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws a bouncy gear forwards and a big gear backwards that rebounds forward, dealing heavy damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}big gear travels 3 tiles backward then rebounds forward
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}plant food will permanently upgrade gear damage

{FLAVOR}Maypop Mechanic always had complaints about having to work in such a hazardous environment. She just can't stand all the steam, smog and rotten mustaches from the nearby factory. Going on a worker strike proved futile, as the zombies weren't particularly fond of having a plant around doing their kind of dirty work in the first place.
UNUSED_49_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Maypop Mechanic launches two gears at zombies. One is launched forward and bounces from zombie to zombie before breaking. The other is launched backwards but rebounds forward while dealing heavy damage to a single target.
UPGRADE_FIND_MORE_TOOLTIP: Use your coins on items that do exist in this reality!
UPGRADE_PF_SLOT_DESCRIPTION: Hold onto one more Plant Food during a level!
UPGRADE_SEEDSLOT_DESCRIPTION: Lets you choose another plant type every level!
UPGRADE_SHOVEL_DESCRIPTION: Get an additional 25% of sun cost back when shoveling up plants!
UPGRADE_STARTING_SUN_DESCRIPTION: Start with 25 extra sun in the bank!
UPGRADE_VALUABLE_MOWERS_DESCRIPTION: Mowers give more coins at the end of the level!
VASE_BREAKER_UNLOCK_PROMPT_DESCRIPTION: Complete Frostbite Caves Day 4 to unlock Vasebreaker
WALLNUT_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Having retired from his days as a champion bowler in the Pro Leagues, Wall-nut is looking forward to a real challenge on the front lines of home defense. DEFENSE! DEFENSE!
WALLNUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Wall-nuts have hard shells which you can use to protect your other plants.
WALLNUT_TOOLTIP: Blocks off zombies and protects your other plants
WASABIWHIP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}prioritizes zombies behind it
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}"The trick to proper whipping is all in the wrist," says Wasabi Whip. "Well, not the wrist, exactly, since I don't have any. You have to, like... BE the wrist."
WASABIWHIP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Wasabi Whips lash out with their flaming whips, delivering whuppings to zombies both in front and behind.
WINTERMELON_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}You may recognize Winter Melon's voice from such incredible documentaries as "It's Cold Up Here," "Ice Bingo," and "Surfin' Swedes."
WINTERMELON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Winter Melons do heavy damage and slow groups of zombies.
WINTERMELON_TOOLTIP: Does heavy damage and slows groups of zombies
WINTERMINT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Winter-mint Family Plants:
{STAT}Boingsetta
{STAT}Cold Snapdragon
{STAT}Hurrikale
{STAT}Ice Bloom
{STAT}Iceberg Lettuce
{STAT}Missile Toe
{STAT}Snow Pea
{STAT}Winter Melon

{FLAVOR}Winter-mint has advanced degrees in cryonics and cryogenics, is a master builder of snowmen, and subscribes to season passes at three different ski resorts. He does think it's a little chilly in here, though.
WINTERMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Winter-mints chill all zombies present on the board when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Winter-mint Family plants on the lawn.
WITCHHAZEL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}can attack targets in the lane above or below, prioritizes leftmost zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}deals damage to zombies that can't be transformed
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}targets Wizard and Frog Sorceress Zombies first

{FLAVOR}Witch Hazel paused, unsure how to proceed. Then, all at once, she knew: Use magic, like, ALL THE TIME!
WITCHHAZEL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Witch Hazels use magical sorcery to transform zombies into Puff-shrooms.
XSHOT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}Sometimes Rotobaga hears the other plants gossiping about each other. "Did you notice that so-and-so has been putting on weight?" they might say. Or, "I hear that so-and-so is dating so-and-so. Can you believe it?"  But Rotobaga isn’t the kind of plant to engage in idle gossip. She’s not interested in talking about anyone behind their leaves. She does her best to just rise above it.
XSHOT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Rotobagas shoot projectiles along the four diagonals, in each direction that has a target.
XSHOT_TOOLTIP: Shoots along the diagonals, up to four directions at a time
YETI_FUE_DIALOG_DESCRIPTION: When a yeti appears on the map, go after him quickly! If you can spot and defeat him in the level, he'll drop fabulous prizes!
ZNAKELILY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}transforms zombies into stronger zomboids depending on their health
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}transforms specific zombies into special zomboids

{FLAVOR}As the zombies amassed their army within the timeline, Znake Lily merely gave a sly, slithery smile. Zomboid seeds in hand (err... tail?), he recalled his ancestor's saying hissed down through generations:

"When in Rome, do as the Romans do."
ZNAKELILY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Znake Lily transforms zombies into helpful zomboids.
ZOMBIE_BARRELROLLER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (barrel) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with barrel
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}imps thrown from barrel when destroyed

{FLAVOR}Barrel Roller Zombie is part of a super underground secret awesome club. You probably haven't heard of it. Also, his left arm is slightly longer than his right arm.
ZOMBIE_BARRELROLLER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His rolling barrel crushes plants and provides excellent protection.
ZOMBIE_BARRELROLLER_EXPLOSIVE_ALMANAC_DE:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (barrel) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with barrel
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}barrel explodes when destroyed
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to freeze effects
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}fire attacks do 20% more damage to the barrel

{FLAVOR}Powder Keg Roller was just your ordinary Barrel Roller Zombie, until his barrel rolled off into the great sea. In a desperate search to find a new one, he found a ragtag group of pirates offering homemade barrels. Unfortunately for him, they weren't homemade barrels, they were made in a factory... a BOMB factory... they're BOMBS.
His rolling barrel explodes when destroyed, and provides excellent protection.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Go to the beach, they said. Put a cone on your head, they said. So, yeah, that's what Pompadour Conehead did. He's at his best when following simple instructions.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His starfish cone gives him twice the toughness of a normal pompadour zombie.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Pompadour Buckethead tried to learn to play the ukulele. He figured it would be easier to learn than the guitar on account of how small it is. But his stiff fingers ... they just weren't made for it. Now he just bangs on his bucket. And he's not half-bad either.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His scallop shelled bucket gives him great resistance to damage.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (conch) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Being constantly called "egghead" in high school drove him to have a more "radical" and "hang 10" personality, but he recently decided to take the name back. Yeah, he’s an egg, and he has a shell. It may not be the right shell, but he’s owning it, isn’t he?
ZOMBIE_BEACH_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His seashell head protection mechanism protects him greatly from damage.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Pompadour Zombie recently noticed that he was wearing only one flip-flop. He THINKS he lost the other one while doing the limbo at a bonfire party the other night. But to be honest, that entire night is a little hazy ... and that flip-flop could be anywhere.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTIO:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}Go back to the beach, they said. Bring a ducky tube, they said. So, yeah, that's what Pompadour Conehead Ducky Tube did. He's still at his best when following simple instructions.
His starfish cone still gives him twice the toughness of regular pompadour ducky tubers.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTIO:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}Previously considered a critically endangered species by thanatologists across the globe, recent conservation efforts to preserve the humble Pompadour Buckethead Ducky Tuber have proven to be more than fruitful. Only downside being is that they've almost entirely outcompeted and devastated the local ecosystem of Big Wave Beach, casualties include the rare Eastern Dragon Seahorse population and multiple coral formations. A bucket makes all the difference.
His scallop-shelled bucket and ducky tube combo give him great resistance to damage.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTIO:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (conch) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}The highly stylish shell on his head is subtly undermined by the implication that his swimming capabilities are reduced to a children's toy.
His fashion statement of a shell greatly protects him from damage.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_DUCKYTUBE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}It caught on.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_DUCKYTUBE_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: With the use of his totally tubular duck floatation apparatus, the Pompadour Ducky Tube Zombie can quickly waddle his way through water.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}See that starfish on Bikini Conehead's cone? She put that there herself. She gets a lot of compliments on it too. And sure enough, now it seems like everyone is accessorizing with starfish. She's a trendsetter, that one.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Her starfish cone makes her twice as tough as a basic bikini zombie.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Bikini Buckethead had big ambitions. She wanted to do more than just lurch around on a beach all day. Her life's dream: to perform internationally with a synchronized swimming team. Sadly, the nose plug was her undoing. If she only had a nose ...
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Her scallop shelled bucket provides great protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (conch) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Some dudes and dudettes think that her shell belonged to something before. Others think that her shell is a rare sea slug, residing on her head. There are few who think that SHE might be the sea slug, but hey, we’ll never really know.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Her seashell, although definitely not the hottest fashion, protects her greatly from damage.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Is it weird that we haven't seen any female zombies before? Some say yes. Some say no. Either way, Bikini Zombie is used to breaking new ground. She's not afraid to go where no woman zombie has gone before. You could call her a pioneer. You could call her a hero.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR1_DESCRI:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}The rubber ducky makes for a nice companion during long nights floating the sea aimlessly.
Her starfish cone and ducky tube combo gives her twice the toughness and style of regular bikini ducky tubers.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR2_DESCRI:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}She stubbed her toe on a rock once.
Her scallop-shelled bucket and ducky tube combo give her great resistance to damage and provides extra style.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR4_DESCRI:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (conch) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}Her shell actually houses one of the great divine sages of a time long past. Mr. Grand Fizzleworth, the snail overlord of universal travel, lives in her shell and frequently tells her stories of intergalactic travel. She keeps trying to alert zombie kind of the threats of intergalactic traveller warriors and their eventual plan to destroy the earth in order to build a planetary parking lot in its place. Mr. Grand Fizzleworth chose her as the messanger, and she must respect that decision. Zombie experts however, have claimed that the shell contains nothing but her head. But she knows better.
Her seashell and ducky tube combo, while being the latest fashion trend, also protects her greatly from damage.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_DUCKYTUBE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}Ever the pioneer, Bikini Ducky Tube Zombie was quick to become the first woman zombie to jump aboard the recent ducky tube hype train. It's not really all it's cracked up to be, but don't tell that reporter lady that she said that. The fallout would ruin her reputation.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FEM_DUCKYTUBE_DESCRIPTION_H: With the use of her gnarly duck floatation apparatus, the Bikini Ducky Tube Zombie can quickly waddle her way through water.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_FISHERMAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1000
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}pulls plants to the right
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}plants next to him are tossed off the lawn

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}500 (plastic wrap) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

Awesome beach party with all his buddies, interesting brains to meet and consume, but then Dr. Zomboss came outta nowhere with his weird shark thing. Next thing he knows, he's stuck at the bottom of the sea, and he's pretty sure he had some scuffle with a sea sponge? He's sure he could take it down.
ZOMBIE_BEACH_GREASER_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Washes out on land, stuck in discarded plastic. When broken free, he'll continue forward - in style.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

You should see how many are living at his house. It's quite startling.

He traveled through remote time periods, where outsiders are seldom seen. He continued his search, never spinning his microphone unless threatened by plants who prey on zombies who foolishly wander into alone through their domain. So do him a favor and buy a copy, won't you?
ZOMBIE_HERO_MC_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Spins microphone to damage nearby plants when he's dropping the most villainous of rhymes.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}She sure is glad that there's water around here in Holiday Mashup. She doesn't feel like she's been scammed at aaaaaaalllll.
ZOMBIE_HERO_NEPTUNA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Waddles in and heroically proceeds not to swim, but walk instead.
ZOMBIE_HERO_PONCHO_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}60 (poncho) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to edible plant effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}randomly wears a protective grate (1100 HP)

{FLAVOR}"Riddle me this, plant with a cape: If flora is so great, how come they're eaten by a zombie with a grate?" says The Grate Mystery, adding "For if a weakness is what you seek, you'll see brainpower isn't for the meek. You cannot know what my attire holds, there's no logical leak. A puzzle which isn't solved, that's what's at stake. Which zombie of all has the knowledge for such a puzzle to make?" Instead of answering any of the riddles, Green Shadow decided to use a Magnet-shroom.
ZOMBIE_HERO_PONCHO_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTION_H: Sometimes has a grate, sometimes he does not. Who is he? He's The Grate Mystery.

{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to edible plant effects

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}incubation tank repairs 400 health to machines every 2 seconds in a 3x3 radius
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can pull off his head

{FLAVOR}Originally Zomboss fan #1, The Brainiac had the seeds of hatred planted in his undead heart after being escorted out of a Meet-N-Greet due to his disruption when it came to the cancellation of the Zombotany Project. If Zomboss won't create more zombotanies, then he will. And he'll show the world how effective of a threat they are. That is, once he gets the formula down, he's still figuring it out and the results have been nothing much more than a breakthrough as an alternative fuel source, which has been used to fund this passion project of his.
ZOMBIE_HERO_REPAIRIMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Drops a home-made incubation tank that (somehow) heals mechanical allies upon defeat.
ZOMBIE_HERO_RUSTBOLT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}320
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to edible plant effects

{FLAVOR}He didn't expect the armor to be this heavy. He didn't expect becoming a zombie with a jetpack either, but sometimes you have to work with what life, or Zomboss, gives you.
ZOMBIE_HERO_RUSTBOLT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Boosts to float over plants heroically.
ZOMBIE_HERO_SMASH_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to edible plant effects
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with chair
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws Impfinity Clone when damaged

{FLAVOR}The Smash has starred in many wrestling matches and is an idol to zombie kind. He’s taken on The Underwearer, Chomp Zilla, and even managed to defeat The Stone after his head flew off into the crowd mid-match. A true hero indeed.
ZOMBIE_HERO_SMASH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Giant zombie who is also a giant fanboy.
ZOMBIE_HERO_STILTWALKER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}650 (steel stilts) + 250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to edible plant effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ignores plants while on steel stilts instead of eating them
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to most knockback while on steel stilts

{FLAVOR}Originally a friendly neighborhood zombie, Steelwalker was bitten by a radioactive imp in his laboratory while conducting an experiment. Fearing the monster he could become, Steelwalker is following a 12-step plan filled with precautions. He's currently on step 3: "Avoid Imp height". Call him paranoid, but you wouldn't want to be turned into an imp either, let alone one that bit you.
ZOMBIE_HERO_STILTWALKER_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Steelwalker's steel stilts allow him to heroically walk right over most plants.
ZOMBIE_HERO_SUPERBRAINZ_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to edible plant effects

{FLAVOR}He never leaves without his mirror. If you're wondering why he doesn't have it now, it's because he's a Jurassic Bully that was stuffed into this stupid suit. He doesn't even know what knockback is, much less something like a mirror. He would probably be freaked out if he saw his own reflection at one point.
ZOMBIE_HERO_SUPERBRAINZ_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: A heroic, damage-resistant zombie who is immune to all knockback.
ZOMBIE_HERO_WEASELHOARDER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}immune to edible plant effects

{FLAVOR}Having come from the ice age, she finds it hard to fit in, even with the unifiying factor of a hero fanclub. No one has the heart to tell her that her origin is not the problem here, but her insistence to bring in a pack of rabid weasels to a convention was not anyone else's idea of a good time.
ZOMBIE_HERO_WEASELHOARDER_DESCRIPTION_HE: Releases a barrage of batty weasels.
ZOMBIE_HERO_WEASEL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Once released, these "bats" will run flightily towards your house!
ZOMBIE_HERO_ZMECH_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}7000
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Orbital Strike attack leaves behind a scorched tile
{KEYWORD}Seasonal Spirit: {STAT}immune to most status effects

{FLAVOR}Z-Mech is taking time out from his PvZ Heroes and PvZ Garden Warfare duties to bring his unique brand of destruction to Plants vs. Zombies 2. Don't worry, though; he's cleared it with his manager.
ZOMBIE_HERO_ZMECH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Deploys a set of summoning and teleportation technologies to harass, damage and otherwise imperil plants on the board.

ZOMBIE_HOLIDAY_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Is launched into your defenses, then works his way forward.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Cave Conehead Zombie was the first zombie to invent the cone. He lashed the horn of a mammoth to a slab of petrified wood ... and boom! A cone! The invention of the cone changed everything for the zombies. EVERYTHING.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His mammoth horn cone makes him twice as tough as normal cave-dwellers.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Cave Buckethead Zombie likes rocks. He likes rocks A LOT. He strapped a rock to his head and called it a bucket. None of the other Cave Zombies know what a "bucket" is, but they like his style.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His stone "bucket" hat provides great protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1600 (iceblock) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}One day, a Cave Zombie fell head-first into a glacial stream. It had been a bad day already, so he lay there in the frigid water for a long time contemplating the insignificance of his life. When he finally stood up, he discovered that his head was encased in ice. At last, his life had meaning! He was unique! He was Blockhead Zombie! At least, that's his story and he's sticking to it.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: The ice block on his head provides amazing protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (tusks) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Rumor has it that Tuskhead Zombie acquired his tusk from the very first version of the Zombot Tuskmaster 10,000 B.C. Dr. Zomboss only lets him keep it because it’s made of ivory, and would rather not be the one having it in his possession.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His mammoth skull protects him greatly from damage.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_CHARRED_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}490
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to fire damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to chill

{FLAVOR}Nobody taught her the story about Icarus. He simply did not exist back then. Long story short, the invention of ski riding has been postponed by a couple thousand years, give or take.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_CHARRED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Elderly zombie that can't be scorched.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_CHIEF_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}630
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.15

{FLAVOR}He was elected as the old leader of his tribe after many trials and tribulations (mostly those involving balloons) until the harsher weather conditions forced his people to merge with another tribe in order to migrate. This whole ordeal had him realize that he really isn't cut out to be #1, and stepping down was for the better. He's also heavily considering settling down and opening up a stand to bring others the same joy that the modest balloon brought to his heart. It's always nice to have dreams in situations like this.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_CHIEF_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Blows cold wind and freezes all plants in the lane.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_CHIEF_MINIBOSS_PHASE1_DESC:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3500 (Phase 1), 3500 (Phase 2)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.1 (Phase 2)
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 3 times the normal damage (Phase 2)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blows freezing blizzards towards plants throughout three lanes
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blows freezing blizzards that can buff and encase zombies in ice
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}stands on one spot, starts walking towards the house after enough damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}50% resistant to fire damage

{FLAVOR}One thing that has always confounded old Edgar G. Zomboss is how can such an unsightly, brutish zombie amass such a gargantuan following? Not only that, he does it with practically no effort! This illiterate, non-Tsiolkovsky equation solving fool! What makes HIM different? Zomboss is currently chalking it up to the height difference and is leaving it at that. In reality, the others greatly fear him due to his sheer apathy of constant balloon crushing. Truly a monster.
The tribal leader, capable of brewing up blizzards throughout the hollows, sending chills to both plants and fellow zombies alike.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_CHIEF_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1260
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}wind boosts zombies' health by 81% and gives them stun immunity for 20 seconds

{FLAVOR}He did what others could not, he crushed a balloon. He shows no mercy.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_CHIEF_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_: Blows a cold wind that strenghtens five zombies in the lane, giving them extra toughness and stun immunity.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Cave Zombie was busy painting handprints on cave walls when he was told to start fighting plants. He's not sure why he's fighting plants, but he hopes he can get back to painting soon. He was feeling inspired. He had plans for some big pieces. Art school was finally paying off.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_DODO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}490
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3

{FLAVOR}Dodo Rider believes dodos are the future of transportation. He believes a public dodo-riding system is not only a wise expenditure of tax dollars but would help the vast majority of zombies get where they need to go more efficiently. Everyone keeps telling him there's no future in dodos, but he refuses to listen.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_DODO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Dodo bird with an imp rider. The dodo can flap and jump over barricades as well as troublesome plants.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_DODO_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}can be disabled by E.M.Peach

{FLAVOR}Robo Dodo actually has a neat ability: an external temperature calculator, designed by Dr. Zomboss himself to keep track of environmental hazards, including excessive cold or heat. It can even calculate the temperature right now: pretty darn cold.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_DODO_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_H: Tankier than the normal non-robotic dodos, Robo Dodos can only fly over one tile, and only fly over certain plants and slider tiles.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Cave Flag Zombie has been in the flag-carrying business for a long time. It's been his life's work. He's good at it. But sometimes, just sometimes, he longs for a change. He wonders if he could be good at something else. He wonders if he could leave it all behind and start fresh. He's pretty sure he's having a mid-life crisis.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge frosty "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}It turns out all he needed to do to free himself from an iceberg was just become a mouth breather. But hey, now he moves faster than everyone else. Slippery feet, teehee.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_H: Marks the arrival of a blizzard of zombies.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with icicle
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}fires off Yeti Imps when damaged

{FLAVOR}Somewhere along the line, Sloth Gargantuar contracted a bad case of Yeti Imps. He used soap, medicinal powders, and a salve made from sloth slobber in an attempt to get rid of them ... to no avail. But the truth is, he's grown used to their presence. The darn things are itchy. They're always squabbling. They nag him endlessly. But at this point, he'd probably miss them if they ever cleared up.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Massive sloth skinned zombie with a case of the imps. Carries and throws three imps instead of just one.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_HUNTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}700
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12

{FLAVOR}Shhhhh ... Hunter Zombie didn't actually kill that sabertooth tiger. He found the skin at a thrift store. Also, he's a vegetarian. Tell no one.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_HUNTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Zombie that can throw snow balls at range to cool down plants until they freeze into blocks.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_HUNTER_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}750
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}snow balls instantly freeze plants and deal 80 damage
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}smashes plants with his club instead of eating, dealing 2 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}He isn't giving it his 100% today, his cousin Eddie came to the village and they went clubbing all night and then some. It was a pretty wild night. He's still pretty hazy about the whole thing, and he's pretty sure a weasel got involved somewhere? He lost his hide wallet too and he's pretty upset about that as well, so it's probably either Eddie or the weasel, and cousin Eddie is no liar.
Zombie that throws an instant freezing snow ball and smashes plants.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Yeti Imp recently took up knitting. He started with a scarf, moved on to mittens and eventually knitted an entire bodysuit out of hair he shaved off of Yeti Zombie. He just loves knitting. When those needles are in his hands, he feels a sense of calm he's never felt before.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Thrown over most of your defenses, then ambles onward.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_TROGLOBITE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}470
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}each ice block has 600 HP

{FLAVOR}Troglobite has been pushing ice blocks across the tundra day in and day out for as long as he can remember. It's cold and exhausting work, and frankly, he's ready for a vacation. He'd like to go somewhere sunny and warm for a change. He'd like to relax in the sand. He hears Big Wave Beach is nice this time of year.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_TROGLOBITE_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Strong zombie that can push blocks of ice across the lawn.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASELHOARDER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}releases zombie ice weasels when damaged

{FLAVOR}Weasel Hoarder claims she's the one who wrote the song "Pop! Goes the Weasel." And for eons now, she's been demanding royalties for it. But everyone just ignores her. They know that Weasel Hoarder can't even carry a tune, much less write a catchy ditty about the sound vermin make when hugged a bit too tightly.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASELHOARDER_DESCRIPTION_: Zombie hiding in a log with a pack of snow weasels. Weasels are released when her log is shattered.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASELHOARDER_VETERAN_DESC:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}900
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}releases zombie permafrost weasels when damaged and yodels for additional weasel support

{FLAVOR}Weasel Queen has always heard that 'Home is where the heart is', but that can't be right as she's been carrying around that log for who knows how long and hasn't gotten any less crummy. Then, it hit her: whoever made up all that mumbo-jumbo must've gotten the organ mixed up, because she is certain that home is exactly where the good food is. In conclusion? Just let her in already!
Zombie with the dangerous power to yodel.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASEL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Once released, weasels run full speed even over ice floes to nibble your brains.
ZOMBIE_ICEAGE_WEASEL_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION: Weasels hardened by the cold, immune to slowdown effects.
ZOMBIE_IMPPEAR_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Their existence is a mystery. Where do they come from? Why are they in their underpants? Why does Birthdayz Barrel Roller cart them around in gifts? He was featured on X-Files once and they still didn't figure it out.
ZOMBIE_IMPPEAR_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Zombies converted into Imps by Imp Pear become Imp Pear Imps.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}480

Teleports zombies forward and summons imps using his magic tricks.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}8000
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons imps and Present Rollers

{FLAVOR}Once a mere skin crawler, he wished to position itself as the new nanny of the imps. And so, through various means, he gained the knowledge to take the form of a big headed Super-Fan Imp, ready to take on a new overseer role, unaware of the one individual who already posseses it...
ZOMBIE_IMPPEAR_OVERSEER_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Marches on a set place on board. From there it summons various small critters.

{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.145

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}causes cowboy zombies to switch lanes

{FLAVOR}He's currently learning the theme song to a popular children's program featuring a purple dinosaur. The Nanny HATES it.
ZOMBIE_IMPPEAR_PIANO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His childish piano tunes cause dancing zombies to switch lanes.
ZOMBIE_LEPRACHAUN_DODO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}490
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects

{FLAVOR}The Leprechaun Imp and the dodo go way back. This unlikely friendship is, in fact, a very clever symbiosis. Leprechaun Imp provides the gold, and the dodo eats the gold. It's a simple process, really.
ZOMBIE_LEPRACHAUN_DODO_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Dodo bird with a Leprechaun Imp rider. The dodo can flap and jump over barricades as well as troublesome plants.
ZOMBIE_LEPRACHAUN_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects

{FLAVOR}There is no convincing him that bathing in gold is unhealthy. One comic book of Zcrooge McDuck was all it took for him to convert his lifestyle.
ZOMBIE_LEPRACHAUN_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Scuddles onto the battlefield with a pot of gold that totally belongs to him.
